7996.title: Agent follow-up dispatch disables interactive approvals
7996.rootCauseOneLine: Follow-up dispatch marks a sender-authored turn as agent; the escalation resolver explicitly denies non-user turns, and runtime-owned approvals return before interaction persistence.
7996.proposedFix: Define delegated approval authority and integrate it with existing authorization, interaction persistence, and notification paths before relaxing the current permission contract.
7996.caveats: Reproduced twice at the server-to-host command boundary with real SQLite; existing runtime denial tests pass. Live macOS/Antigravity final-output behavior is unverified. No automatic PR: changing permissions and security policy is outside the simple-fix criteria. The complete reproduction is inline in the HTML under the reports repository's artifact policy.
